# PiTTy v0.5.19

## Mission-Backed Workflow Visibility

- Mission-backed foreground workflow children remain visible live when chat progress is disabled, with exact session/workflow identities and duplicate-free terminal/persisted reconciliation.
- Child session and transcript access remains available, with stable selected-transcript behavior across updates.
- Valid upstream `paused` and `stopped` children remain visible as inactive, read-only rows.
- Legacy `details.results` and `details.progress` details remain supported.

## Inspector Navigation

- `Ctrl+Arrow` cycles inspector selections while preserving native word navigation in the main prompt.

Regression coverage and a restarted production smoke test validate these behaviors.
